title: Amazon policy knowledge base for CasePilot
source_scope: Public Amazon/Seller Central guidance; not Amazon internal policy.

returns.general_guidance: Most items may be returned within 30 days, but the applicable return period can vary by product/category.
returns.rule: Always check the specific product/category return eligibility and applicable return window.

non_returnable.exception_guidance: Some non-returnable items may still qualify for refund/replacement when damaged, defective, or materially different, subject to applicable policy.

returnless_resolution.guidance: A refund or replacement without return may be available for qualifying cases/products.
returnless_resolution.rule: Check the specific SKU/product/case eligibility; do not assume returnless eligibility.

refunds.seller_fulfilled_guidance: Amazon Seller Central guidance states seller-fulfilled refunds should be processed within two business days after receipt of a returned item.
verification: Check whether a refund already exists

a_to_z_guarantee.guidance: For qualifying Marketplace Seller cases, A-to-z Guarantee processes may apply; check applicable eligibility and gather delivery/return evidence.
checks: Whether a payment-provider refund/chargeback already occurred

return_request_response.guidance: Amazon Seller Central guidance states sellers should respond to return requests within 48 hours.
